$comment: Issue #1568 - desktop initial-bundle size budget. Run via `npm run check:bundle`. Values are bytes; `null` skips the limit on that axis. Bump these intentionally, not by accident - every regression visible in CI costs a hot path.

$maxRawHistory.reason: Issue #1530 added the PTY input retry buffer (`src/lib/terminalInputQueue.ts`) to the entry chunk: +4,567 B minified, +1.5 kB gzipped (326.6 -> 328.1 kB). The cap had 8.2 kB of headroom on main, of which ~4.5 kB is Windows-vs-Linux build variance for the same source, so CI landed 910 B over. Raised to absorb the variance as well as the feature, so an unrelated future diff cannot tip it for reasons that have nothing to do with that diff. The gzip cap is deliberately unchanged: it is the axis that governs transfer, and it retains ~23 kB of headroom.

PR #2080 added the circuit Run Card's wall-clock labels and the "What to do next" recovery panel to the Probe entry chunk via `src/components/Probe/CircuitRunCard.tsx` and `src/components/Circuits/runIdentity.ts` (+2.3 kB minified raw). The Run History Drawer, historyPresentation, and RunNextStepsPanel code-split into `CircuitsProbeTab-*.js` so they do not count here. Bumping the raw cap by 10 kB absorbs the feature plus a small margin for future probe-include fixes; the gzip cap stays unchanged at 360 kB (the axis that governs first-paint transfer) and the entry CSS cap is unaffected.

Issue #2151 added the per-harness permission-mode UI to the entry chunk: the mode select plus effective-mode line in `src/components/AppSettings/HarnessDefaultsSection.tsx` and the mode line on Spawn Menu rows in `src/components/Providers/GroupedProviderMenu.tsx` (+4.8 kB minified raw, measured 1124897 B vs the 1120000 B cap). The mode labels and descriptions ride over IPC at runtime so only the controls count here. Bumping the raw cap by 10 kB absorbs the feature plus a small margin; the gzip cap stays unchanged at 360 kB (transfer axis retains ~24 kB of headroom) and the entry CSS cap is unaffected (no new styles — existing utilities only).

PR #2249 bumped @tauri-apps/api from 2.11.x to 2.12.x (and aligned the four @tauri-apps/plugin-* JS packages with their resolved Rust crate versions from #2211) so `tauri-build`'s preflight would accept the tauri 2.12.x / plugin 2.4.x / 2.7.x / 2.13.x Cargo resolved minors. The 2.12.x JS API surface added +450 B minified raw (measured 1,130,450 B vs the 1,130,000 B cap) to the entry chunk. Aligning the JS floor to the exact Rust resolved versions (instead of the latest patch) keeps the lockfile and `Cargo.lock` on the same point-release, which avoids further per-patch churn on the next dependabot run. Bumping the raw cap by 10 kB absorbs the bump plus a small margin; the gzip cap stays unchanged at 360 kB (transfer axis retains ~22 kB of headroom) and the entry CSS cap is unaffected.

Circuit Activity/History can restore closed review agents through the existing Agent History helper. Loading that helper on demand creates one shared lazy chunk and adds 32 B to the initial chunk's preload map (Windows baseline 1139995 B, changed 1140027 B). The baseline had only 5 B of raw headroom. Raising the raw cap by 1 kB accommodates the manifest entry with a small margin; restoration code remains lazy, and the gzip and CSS caps stay unchanged.
